condition_name.Description: COCO ID of the stimulus that is displayed. Defaults to 0 for events that do not involve a stimulus presentation.

stim_name.Description: Name of the stimulus, which can refer to the image path in case of image presentation, the corrected caption in case of caption presentation, 'Fix' for fixation events, 'ImgInst' for imagery instruction events, or 'Img' for the imagery trial (during which the subjects were imagining the previously instructed scene.

Levels.0: The trial is not a one-back target.
Levels.1: The trial is a one-back target.
Levels.2: The trial is a one-back target (cross-modal).

train_test.Description: Indicates whether the stimulus belongs to the training set or to the test set.

Levels.1: The stimulus belongs to the training set.
Levels.2: The stimulus belongs to the test set.

subj_resp.Description: Indicates whether the subject pressed the response button (as instructed for one-back target trials)

Levels.0: The response button was not pressed

imagert.Description: Indicates whether the current trial is an imagery trial

Levels.0: The current trial is not an imagery trial.
Levels.1: The current trial is an imagery trial.

imagery_scene.Description: The scene that was being imagined. Before the start of the fMRI experiment, the participants had learning a mapping from 3 numbers to 3 visual scenes (based on 3 captions selected by the participant).

Levels.1: The subject was instructed to imagine scene 1.
Levels.2: The subject was instructed to imagine scene 2.
Levels.3: The subject was instructed to imagine scene 3.

imagery_pos.Description: The position of the imagery trial within the run.

Levels.1: The imagery trial was at the beginning of the run
Levels.2: The imagery trial was at the end of the run
